{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue and count
n_completed = len(completed_filtered)
total_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

n_completed, total_revenue"}
